company.name: GloPos
company.shortDescription: GloPos develops advanced software-only positioning solutions for accurate indoor and outdoor mobile location tracking.
company.description: GloPos is the developer of GlobalMPS, an accurate Cell-ID based, software-only positioning technology. GlobalMPS enables location applications to show the exact indoor position of the mobile phones. It’s self-learning algorithms calculate an accurate position even in places where no GPS is available (i.e. in shopping malls, subways, underground parking, airports, sports arenas, exhibition centers). The technology works wherever GSM network coverage is available. GlobalMPS can also be used for making wi-fi positioning more accurate.

productsAndServices.description: A software-based positioning technology that calculates the location of mobile devices outdoors, indoors, and underground using cellular networks without additional hardware.
productsAndServices.name: Glopos Mobile Positioning

productsAndServices.description: An inertial navigation system using only accelerometer and gyroscope data to track device movement in 3D space without external signals or hardware.
productsAndServices.name: Glopos Unconstrained Inertial Navigation
